answer: Agents sit in walnut shells, pockets of trust, fog between them. Crossing costs $5 times the same-shell identities crossing that cut this epoch, each leaving a sable mark. One honest agent pays $5. A hundred clones from one shell pay $500 each, $50,000 in all; a hundred honest agents apart pay $500. A new shell pays $200 entry per identity, so spreading clones still costs $20,000. Seven cut auditors follow each whisper and check crossings at close. A caught cluster falls to zero weight for ten epochs, tolls burned. One traveler pays a coin; a village marching together pays a fortune.
